actor_notes: LOOKS: lean elf with ink-stained sleeves and a travelling cloak repaired at both shoulders. CORE: teaching is how a household survives being driven away. NATURE: dry humour, patient with learners, impatient with flattery. WOUND: forced to choose what books and possessions could be carried. WANTS: pupils safe and stolen heritage returned. PRESSURE: retreats into exact answers and independent action. KEY: measured plain speech, sparse figurative language.
